title: Overview
sentences: Let me walk you through this loan default risk dashboard.
It brings applicant assessment, predictions, and model explanations together in one place.

title: Portfolio analytics
sentences: We start with the analytics dashboard for a quick view of the applicant pool.
The charts show repayment outcomes and how applicants are distributed across different groups.

title: Financial details
sentences: To assess an applicant, we enter their annual income and loan amount.
The form also includes optional details, like the loan annuity and goods price.

title: Applicant profile
sentences: Next, we complete the applicant profile, including age, employment, family details, and housing.
I've shortened the data entry here so we can focus on the workflow.

title: Run the assessment
sentences: External credit scores can be added when available, or left blank.
Once the details are ready, we select Assess risk to generate the estimate.

title: Prediction result
sentences: For this example, the estimated default probability is seven point six percent.
The dashboard shows a risk score of eight out of one hundred, in the low risk band.

title: Interpret the result
sentences: This is an analytical estimate, not a guaranteed outcome or an automatic lending decision.
The result still needs human review.

title: Explain the prediction
sentences: The explainability page shows which features are associated with the model's predictions.
It also includes an applicant level breakdown to help us understand this particular result.

title: Compare models
sentences: Model Selection compares the candidates using cross validation.
Here, X G Boost is selected, with the comparison results and tuning details available for review.

title: Check performance
sentences: The performance page brings together test metrics, threshold analysis, and calibration.
These views help us examine how the model behaves beyond a single prediction.

title: Methodology and reference
sentences: For more detail, the methodology pages explain the formulas behind the scores.
The feature reference documents the inputs, derived features, and how missing values are handled.

title: Model information
sentences: Finally, Model Information records the model version and training details.
Together, these pages make the assessment easier to inspect, explain, and review.
